scripts._check:format: prettier --check theme/assets *.md theme/i18n theme/scripts scripts tests
scripts._netlify:prepare: npm run -s is:clean && npm run install:safe && npm run -s is:clean && npm run -s _netlify:set-build-id
scripts._netlify:set-build-id: test -n "$COMMIT_REF" || { echo 'COMMIT_REF is not set' >&2; exit 1; } && npm run -s set:version -- --id "$(echo "$COMMIT_REF" | cut -c1-8)"
scripts._prepare: npm run _prepare:scrollspy-patch && npm run _refresh-forward-sass-var && npm run _gen-chroma-styles
scripts._test:fix-clean: npm run fix-for-test && npm run -s is:clean
scripts.approve:hugo: npm run _install:safe:pre && npm approve-scripts --allow-scripts-pin hugo-extended && npm run -s _test:supply-chain && npm run _install:safe:post
scripts.check:afdocs:dev: npm run -s _check:afdocs -- http://localhost:1313 | awk '/./{if(s)printf "%s",b; b=""; print; s=1; next} s{b=b RS}' | tee docsy.dev/content/en/docs/content/agent-support/afdocs-scorecard.txt
scripts.check:format: npm list prettier && npm run _check:format && npm run -s -C docsy.dev check:format || (echo '[help] Run: npm run fix:format'; exit 1)
scripts.check: npm run check:format && npm run check:markdown
scripts.fix-and-test: echo 'RUNNING most FIXES AND TESTS...'; npm run fix-for-test && npm run test:website && npm run test:repo
scripts.fix-for-test: npm run fix:format && npm run fix:markdown && npm run -C docsy.dev fix
scripts.fix:format: npm run -s _check:format -- --write && echo && npm run -s -C docsy.dev fix:format
scripts.fix: npm run fix:format && npm run fix:markdown && npm run -C docsy.dev fix
scripts.seq: bash -c 'for cmd in "$@"; do npm run $cmd || exit 1; done' -
scripts.test:full: npm run _test:full:pre && npm run check && npm run test:website && npm run _test:full:common
scripts.update::post:
echo; echo 'IMPORTANT! Run the following in case the ScrollSpy patch needs to be updated:
  npm run _prepare'; echo
scripts.update:goldens: npm run -C docsy.dev update:goldens && npm run update:markup-goldens && npm run update:scripts-goldens
scripts.update:theme-dep: bash -c 'node scripts/update-dep.mjs "$1" --workspace=theme "$2" && npm run -s _sync:theme-lock && npm run -s install:theme-deps && npm run -s update::post' -
scripts.zzz: echo 'This is just a placeholder that is the last script in this script collection.'
